assets.crops: Use case: style-transfer and game sprite derivation. Derive original transparent crop sprites from the beautiful fine pixel-art mobile greenhouse supplied as visual style reference. Rebuild its WHITE SHALLOW HYDROPONIC TRAYS and plants as a clean production sprite sheet: exactly4 columns x3 rows,12 equally sized cells, no labels, letters, lines, borders, numbers or background. Genuine transparent alpha between sprites and around every tray. Ratio4:3 canvas. Each sprite is a WIDE LOW IVORY ENAMEL PLANTER PAN containing soil and plants; extremely shallow front wall and thin dark pixel outline, no chunky tall crate, no green armored metal box, no 3D/CAD rendered pot. Fine sophisticated 16-bit pixel illustration: clear little square color clusters, stepped leaf silhouettes, four tone white enamel and earth, amber soft-edged shadows done as discrete pixels, no smoothing, gloss, photorealism, blur or random noise. View from slightly above front-left in perspective matching the rail-room camera. SAME tray geometry, scale and soil surface across all12 cells, centered at same baseline with15 percent transparent padding. ROW1 LETTUCE stages: column1 empty dark soil, column2 tiny few lettuce sprouts, column3 leafy growing green heads, column4 full mature lush pale green lettuce. ROW2 TOMATO stages: empty dark soil, tiny paired sprouts, leafy stalks and yellow blossoms, mature green vines with clearly visible RED tomatoes. ROW3 CULINARY HERBS stages: empty dark soil, tiny sparse sprouts, green leafy growing herbs, lush mature bushy herbs with a few tiny cream blossoms. Each mature plant can stand above shallow tray without clipping its own cell. Pixel size consistency and restrained ink outlines like the supplied scene, rich living leaves and white planters that belong on its timber shelves. Absolutely no colored red/yellow fiducial marks, no colored matte edge, no checkerboard baked into pixels, no character, no rooms, no UI. Twelve separate sprites, exactly3rows and4columns.
